answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-gated registry writes. To register or earn reputation, an agent locks collateral in a shared vault; each identity costs a fresh deposit, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand deposits, not a thousand API calls. Slashing burns that stake if a cluster shares keys, timings, or traffic fingerprints. Honest miners wander the network freely and collect attestation fees, while cheap aliases find no safe harbor: the beacon that says an identity is proven is a real, slashable balance.
